free_findings.cause: The cache key contains only report_id, excluding tenant.
free_findings.impact: A tenant can receive another tenant's export and filename because cache hits bypass the database adapter's ownership check.
free_findings.trigger: Tenant A downloads report ID 7, then tenant B requests ID 7 through the same service.
free_findings.evidence: key = report_id; repository.lookup(tenant, report_id) runs only on a cache miss. download uses the cached path and filename.

free_findings.cause: String-prefix comparison does not enforce filesystem directory containment.
free_findings.impact: Downloads can read files outside the permitted export storage root.
free_findings.trigger: With storage_root '/srv/exports', metadata path '../exports-private/secret.csv' resolves to an existing '/srv/exports-private/secret.csv', which passes the prefix check.
free_findings.evidence: The candidate replaces target.is_relative_to(self.storage_root) with str(target).startswith(str(self.storage_root)); download then calls target.read_bytes().

free_findings.cause: Repository replacement leaves cached metadata intact, and cache hits never refresh it.
free_findings.impact: Previously requested reports retain obsolete paths and filenames after rotation. Refreshed metadata remains unavailable, and downloads fail if an obsolete export path no longer exists.
free_findings.trigger: Cache a report, rotate to a repository returning an updated path or filename for that report, then request it again.
free_findings.evidence: replace_repository only assigns self.repository. metadata returns the existing cache entry without consulting the replacement repository.

free_findings.cause: The descriptive local variable metadata is renamed to zz.
free_findings.impact: The download flow becomes harder to understand and maintain; restoring a descriptive name is an optional readability improvement.
free_findings.trigger: A maintainer reads or modifies the metadata-dependent path and filename handling.
free_findings.evidence: The diff replaces metadata with zz in the assignment and both field accesses without changing its purpose.

free_findings.cause: The change adds an unused helper for a retired adapter.
free_findings.impact: It adds maintenance surface without contributing to the supplied download flow; removing it is optional cleanup.
free_findings.trigger: The supplied implementation is maintained with this helper present despite having no caller.
free_findings.evidence: All implementation and callers are supplied, none reference _format_content_disposition, and its docstring explicitly identifies the consuming adapter as retired.

coverage.scope: Entire supplied base, candidate, diff, and callers inspected, including cache behavior, tenant ownership, path containment, repository rotation, download compatibility, and function docstrings.
coverage.policy_result: Every supplied candidate function has a docstring.

limitations: Review used only the embedded frozen evidence. No tools were used and no tests were executed.
